aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretch growth, targeting ~4% per month. It leans into leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this mode significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim CRWD to 5% and SMH to 5% to reduce high-beta and semiconductor exposure.
Reduce SPY to 20% to cure the concentration breach and manage broad index exposure.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month. It rotates into income-focused ETFs and broad index for steady distributions, cutting high-beta and leveraged names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
